title: Son of the Soil
logline: Follow the story of a former Nigerian soldier Zion Ladejo, tortured by his past and is forced to return to Nigeria as a result of his beloved sister’s untimely death. Determined to find those responsible, he embarks on a quest for vengeance and in the process seeks redemption for his past actions.
starring:
Raz Adoti, Patience Ozokwor, Iretiola Doyle, Sunshine Rosman, Taye Arimoro, 
Philip Asaya, Damilola Ogunsi, Durotimi Okutagidi, Emeka Golden, James ‘BlacQ’ Damilare, and Sharon Rotimi
producer: Andreas Roald, Ioanna Karavela, Chee Keong Cheung, Raz Adoti, and Wingonia Ikpi.
production_companies: Sovereign Films, Action Xtreme, Boxonia Blueprint (In Association with)

title: NollyBabes
logline: after another failed audition, a rising nollywood star and her two best friends try to con a sleazy director to fund their own film.
producer_companies: boxonia bleuprint & gap tooth smile productions.

title: Beta Food, Beta Life
logline: A USAID ambassador, Chioma Akpotha, is invited by a women-leader from a northern community to sensitize the women of this community on nutrition.
starring: Chioma Akpotha, Daddy Showkey, Ummi Baba Ahmed, Miriam ‘Shytalker’ Peters, Habiba Shehu Zocksock

title: otana
logline: Otana centres around Peace, a young lady facing sexual trauma. In a moment of luck, Peace meets a demon escaping hell and they bond over a common ground of pain and vengeance.
starring: Evelyn John, Uche Chika E.,Tolu Odebunmi, Olawande Adetula, Victory Eyong Osuwake, Chinyere Ogbonnaya
